provenance: Derived from pot_all failures involving wrong columns, total-row handling, top-k, and inclusive ranges.

semantic_labels.label: table.column_row_binding
semantic_labels.description: Bind computations to exact requested rows/columns and handle totals/ranges carefully.

scope.observed_error: wrong filters, wrong top-k rows, total rows, or year ranges changed the answer

payload.content: Bind the computation to the exact columns, rows, and range named in the question. Treat year/date ranges as inclusive, exclude `total` or summary rows unless explicitly requested, and verify top/bottom-k selections before computing the final value.

rationale: Targets multi-hop and time-based errors caused by selecting the wrong row/column subset.
